== NAME

cell-notes - cell footnotes

== DESCRIPTION

Outer footnote:same[Outernote.] and footnote:same[].

|===
|
First footnote:same[Firstnote.] and footnote:same[].

[cols=a,options=noheader]
!===
!

!===

|
